courseName: Bachelor of Global Studies / Bachelor of Laws (Honours) Conjoint

overseasQualifications.description: Entry is by invitation for high-achieving LLB Part II students.

achievements.description: To be considered for the honours programme, you must achieve a B+ average or higher across all your law courses at the completion of LLB Part II. For conjoint students this is usually at the end of their third year.

alternativePaths.description: Bridge your educational gap with a preparation and foundation programme . If you have an offer of place from us that is conditional on meeting English language requirements, you may be considered for English Pathway courses from the University of Auckland English Language Academy (ELA)
